blocks.html: 37ft Offshore Catamaran – Private Fishing Charter in San José del Cabo

The 37ft Offshore Catamaran offers a private offshore sportfishing experience for groups of up to six guests departing from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo.

What distinguishes this 37-foot fishing catamaran is its combination of a twin-hull design, four outboard engines, and a spacious open fishing deck. This configuration provides a wide fishing platform with additional stability, making it an appealing choice for anglers who prioritize fishing space and offshore performance.

The boat features comfortable seating and advanced navigation electronics, offering a practical setup for experienced anglers and small groups planning an offshore fishing adventure.

Its open deck provides room for anglers to move while fighting fish, while the elevated stability of the catamaran design contributes to a comfortable fishing experience under suitable sea conditions.

From San José del Cabo, fishing trips may explore offshore grounds such as Gordo Banks and Iman Bank, depending on weather, ocean conditions, and seasonal fish activity. Potential target species include yellowfin tuna, dorado (mahi-mahi), wahoo, and marlin.

Each private charter includes fishing rods, reels, basic tackle, bottled water, and soft drinks. Fishing licenses, bait, meals, transportation, and additional services should be confirmed before booking.

Private fishing charter for 1–6 guests. Contact Exotic Fish Cabo for current pricing and availability.
